t: Created by Henry VIII in 1542 to replace the Lordship of Ireland, with its own parliament but the English monarch as king.
Tudor and Stuart wars and plantations transferred most land to Protestant settlers, and the Penal Laws excluded Catholics from power.
After winning legislative independence in 1782 and the 1798 rebellion, it was merged into the United Kingdom from 1801.
dyk: Handel’s Messiah had its first performance not in London but in Dublin, at the Great Music Hall on Fishamble Street in April 1742.
ev: Henry VIII’s title of King of Ireland takes effect under the Crown of Ireland Act
English victory at the Battle of Kinsale over Irish and Spanish forces
Oliver Cromwell storms Drogheda and Wexford
William III defeats James II at the Battle of the Boyne
First of the Penal Laws restricting Catholics is enacted
The United Irishmen rebellion is crushed

f.successor: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
